adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` line is removed and the associated `category_id` lookup and `PostCreator.new(..., category: category_id)` usage are deleted. The import now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` with no category parameter. This is a backwards-incompatible CLI regression that will break existing automation invoking `--category`/`-c` and silently changes where topics are created.
